description.narrative: Based in Jamaica, Women's Resource and Outreach Centre Limited promotes gender equality and the empowerment of women and girls through engagement in economic, social, and political life at different levels. They offer a variety of programs aimed at creating social and economic development in both urban and rural communities, with a focus on gender equality and justice, health and wellness, sustainable livelihoods, environmental management, and community capacity strengthening. Their work is centered on advancing women and girls through skills development, counselling, training, research, advocacy, and public education. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Organizational costs such as staff salaries, accounting fees, bank fees, office utilities, and others; - Capacity strengthening, awareness raising and provision of services, including water tanks, to vulnerable and marginalized populations.
